name: ROMET-RNA
description: This record contains the source code and benchmark data supporting the manuscript “ROMET-RNA benchmarks and selects RNA 3D structures using multiple predictors and alignment strategies”. The archive includes the ROMET-RNA implementation, installation and usage instructions, benchmark target information, and per-target evaluation results. The contents and organization of the archived files are described in README.md.
